text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Dober! Your birthday present 
was very big fabulous.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm glad it suited your palate. It was 
a special order of a local bento 
specialty.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes. An elegant flavor, a danceable savory 
depth... every bit of it came racing 
straight through my heart—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It came to me... the local scenery, that 
breathtaking view—! Once again, berry 
thank you, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wh-When you put it like that, I 
almost feel bad...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a special local attachment or 
sentiment like you do, Pearl-san... I just 
picked it because I heard good things 
through word of mouth—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, in that case— Let's do it together! 
Dober!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Your present completely knocked me out, 
and I just decided on my next travel 
destination— Ah, I thought, I really want 
to visit there in real life someday...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But you just said you thought of 
something...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone starts out imaginary... In the 
beginning, everything is unknown—that is 
local culture.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yet from that, the next voyage is born... 
The unknown becomes the known... Fufufu, 
it's quite thrilling, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Shall we go local? Let's go together! 
Dober!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—H-Hehe...! When Pearl-san puts it that 
way... I kind of feel like I can really do 
it.
